proposed_facts.reason: Independently checked both cited canonical ranges. Initial read failures return NOCARD; scramble persists across DSP submission; flash ID is written before the initial READY return. DoneCallback releases EXI for either transaction failure or failed presence probe. Following a successful probe, only READY with bit 0x40 clear is converted locally to IOERROR with EXI release; other status results are forwarded unchanged. The proposal and functionality document agree. Existing names and inherited retained knowledge remain unchanged.
